importHint: Reads xmlUrl from the file and uses folder outlines as group paths. You can add a shared prefix as a top-level folder for this import. Each feed is created with the existing API and fetched immediately to catch up the current snapshot.

fields.name: Name
fields.namePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the feed title
fields.nameHint: Optional. If empty, the first successful fetch writes the feed’s own title.
fields.groupHint: Slash path used to build the sidebar tree. Leave empty for ungrouped.
fields.groupInvalid: Group cannot contain . or .. path segments.
fields.intervalRange: Interval must be between 1 minute and 24 hours.
fields.numberPatternHint: Optional. When set, only this regex is used (first capture group if present); built-in extraction is skipped.
fields.contentTypeHint: Media content category — determines crawler routing.
fields.useCacheHint: Checked caches are reused; unchecked means force-refresh that kind.
fields.enabledHint: When off, the feed is not polled on a schedule. Fetch now still works.
fields.autoEnqueueHint: When off, fetches still run and history is recorded, but new numbers are not scraped automatically. Scrape selected items from history.
